title: About me: a form
subtitle: Name, age, city, hobbies — the first form you fill in
goal: You can fill in a simple form about yourself: name, age, city, school, hobby, and one sentence about what you like.
why: Every language school, hostel, competition and online course starts with a form. If you can fill it in without help, nobody has to translate for you.
example: Aigerim filled in a form for a free online course. Eight lines, no mistakes — and she was accepted the same evening.
writeTask: Fill in a form about yourself (30–50 words): your name, age, city, school, one hobby and one sentence about your plans.
